name: Casing / volute
description: Contains the liquid and converts velocity to pressure

name: Impeller
description: Transfers rotational energy to the liquid

name: Wear rings
description: Set clearances between impeller and casing (S-01 pp.16 and 35); new in KR-1

name: Shaft
description: Transmits torque from driver to impeller

name: Coupling
description: Connects motor shaft to pump shaft

name: Suction line
description: Suction piping, strainer, suction valve, flanges, foot valve

name: Discharge line
description: Discharge piping, discharge valve, check valve

name: Process liquid
description: Liquid properties: temperature, gas content, solids, density, viscosity
